materials.note: AISC 360-22 Sec I1.3: the concrete limits are for the available strength; Fy above 525 MPa is used at the limit

sources.method: AISC 360-22 Sec I1.2a: plastic stress distribution
sources.materials: AISC 360-22 Sec I1.3: f'c 21-69 MPa (normal weight), 21-41 MPa (lightweight) for the available strength; Fy at most 525 MPa
